user.title: Smart Shutter Control
user.description: The base controller holds the settings for all shutters. Add the shutters afterwards on the integration page.

data_description.pv_power: One or more sensors; they are added up. Used as a measure of clouds.
data_description.pv_peak: Peak power of the panels, for the expected power in clear sky.
data_description.wind_gust: Optional; the storm limit applies to the wind speed and the gusts.

data_description.pv_power: One or more sensors; they are added up. Used as a measure of clouds.
data_description.pv_peak: Peak power of the panels, for the expected power in clear sky.
data_description.wind_gust: Optional; the storm limit applies to the wind speed and the gusts.

data_description.storm_limit: Above this wind speed or gust shutters are only fully open or fully closed.

data_description.cover: The existing cover entity that moves the shutter. It must support a position.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the shutter's name.
data_description.tilt: 90 = vertical window; less for a roof window.
data_description.min_elevation: Below this elevation the sun is blocked, e.g. by buildings.
data_description.max_elevation: Above this elevation the sun is blocked, e.g. by an overhang.
data_description.max_position: Automatic control never opens the shutter further; by hand it can.
